WWF WrestleMania 2000: Recompiled (beta)
========================================

A native PC port of WWF WrestleMania 2000 (N64), produced by static
recompilation. This download contains NO game assets — you must own the game
and supply your own ROM of the USA V1.2 release.

Getting started
---------------
1. Unzip this folder anywhere and run Wm2kRecompiled.exe.
2. Click "Load ROM" and select your WWF WrestleMania 2000 (USA, V1.2) ROM
   (SHA1 D7D1FAD473FEF9B61FE5F8273C975EE7C603A51B). The launcher validates
   and remembers it. Earlier revisions (V1.0/V1.1) are not accepted.
3. Click "Start Game".

Notes
-----
- Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe is unsigned:
  "More info" -> "Run anyway".
- Saves and settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Wm2kRecompiled\. Both the cart
  save and the virtual Controller Pak persist automatically. To make the
  install portable instead, create an empty file named portable.txt next to
  the exe.
- A log file (Wm2kRecompiled.log) is written to the same folder — include
  it when reporting bugs.
- F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen.

Project page, source code, and issue tracker:
https://github.com/jessetbh/WWFWrestleMania2000Recomp
